meta.pathsContainSpaces: Quote every path in shell/import tooling.

iconTreatment: Inline the SVG in the DOM, delete the baked fill="#fff", set fill:currentColor on the path; the glyph then inherits the element's color and auto-matches all 3 themes. Rest color inherits --ink-soft; active/selected inherits --accent-ink (nav) or the slot's semantic var. Every chosen icon is a single-path game-icons.net glyph so this rule works uniformly — no baked-color Kenney assets were kept, to avoid a grey/gradient icon sitting next to gold line art.

nav.discover.note: Clean, instantly legible search glyph at 22-24px. lorc/spyglass.svg is the cozier period alt but the telescope shape reads ambiguously at nav size, and delapouite/archive-research.svg (magnifier+book) is too busy small.

nav.care.note: Classic pad+4-toes paw; the flat variant is the most legible paw at small size. paw-heart is a warmer alt but combines two concepts.

nav.habitat.note: Rounded cozy dwelling; matches the detail level of the rest of the nav set better than a plain house. Fallback: delapouite/house.svg if it muddies at final render size.

nav.progress.note: Bold upward growth arrow, reads as advancement instantly and stays distinct from the content seedling/sprout. lorc/sprout is the cozier alt but collides conceptually with content.sprout.

nav.books.note: Shelved books = 'your library', distinct from the discover magnifier and the reading open-book action. book-pile is a fine cozy alt.

nav.settings.note: Single clean gear, the conventional settings glyph and the cleanest of the three at 22px. Reuse the same file for the two debug-gear buttons (.preview-debug, .creature-debug) currently using the emoji.

content.gift.note: Wrapped box reads as 'gift' instantly (welcome gift-stack). lorc/gift-of-knowledge (gift+book) is thematic but reads as an open book, not a present.

content.heart.note: Despite the plural filename this renders as one clean plain heart, the closest thing to a bare heart in the set. Tint --warm for the affection/care meter. heart-beats is the alt if a vitality-EKG read is wanted.

content.moon.note: Clean crescent+disc; the candlelit/spooky-cozy nighttime marker.

content.sleep.note: Crescent moon with Z-z-z; unambiguous 'sleep' state, pairs with the tuck-in action.

content.sparkle.note: Twinkle cluster for reward/growth bursts. Tint --accent-ink for the candle-gold glow.

content.sprout.note: Potted sprout for the growth/stage chip. Tint --good (green) for the one intentional cool accent, reads as 'alive/growing'.

content.star.note: Rounded 5-point filled star; the clean rating star. Rejected lorc/flat-star (renders as an ornate swirled shuriken, not a plain star).

content.emptyStar.note: DELIBERATE deviation from catalog: reuse the SAME round-star glyph for the empty state (fill --line, or fill:none + stroke:currentColor) rather than importing Kenney's star_outline. Kenney's outline is a different silhouette AND baked grey — mixing it into a gold currentColor rating row looks off. One glyph, two fills = silhouette-consistent and fully themeable.

inline.camera.note: Plain camera for the .photo-btn snapshot action (replaces the current inline emoji).

inline.check.note: Bold clean check, currentColor-ready — beats both baked Kenney checkmarks. Tint --good for confirm states.

inline.arrowNext.note: Chosen over Kenney's arrow_basic_e specifically to keep the whole set currentColor + one visual family; the Kenney arrow is baked grey/gradient and would clash. Reads as a media 'skip/next' triangle-with-bar, acceptable for a next affordance.

creatureAssemblyNotes: Parts are individually-cropped PNG sprites (verified: body_redA 165x165, arm_redA 82x176, leg_redA 72x167, ear 54x54, eye 64x69, mouth 80x24, nose 47x51), NOT full-canvas aligned — so assembly is absolute-positioned /background layers with per-part offsets the developer hand-tunes, not a simple 0,0 stack. arm/leg/detail/eye are SINGLE sprites: place two copies and mirror one (transform: scaleX(-1)) for symmetry. Color is fixed by the chosen PNG variant (no CSS recolor). Warm read confirmed by test composite: 'red'=coral/rose, 'dark'=warm brown, 'yellow'=golden; keep blue/green out except tiny cool accents. Use the vector-emoji No-Outline mood faces (catalog.creatureMoods) as a separate care-state badge overlay, not baked into the body.

font.fontBodyValue: unchanged (keep the existing per-theme sans stack in --font; Eczar is a heavy display serif, wrong for long body copy at small sizes)

weightMap.800 ExtraBold: large numerals — stat/meter/level numbers for punch

font.notes: Set --font-display to the Eczar stack once in :root. This UNIFIES the display face across all 3 themes — nook & spellbook already use serifs so it fits; schoolhouse currently uses a casual Chalkboard display, so Eczar changes its personality (flag for sign-off, though the brief's 'serif display type' points this way). Ship gotcha: only .ttf is provided — mock can load .ttf via format('truetype'), but convert to woff2 (fonttools/pyftsubset) before production for size; also subset to Latin. Alternatively load eczar/Eczar-VariableFont_wght.ttf once and drive weights via font-weight.

parchment.how: FelisChaus_ParchmentBackground.jpg as a very-low-opacity (~5-8%) warm grain overlay on PAPER surfaces only — .book-card, the reading popup, .nameplate — via a ::before with mix-blend-mode: soft-light, background-size tiled (380x421 is small, so tile; seams vanish at that opacity). Adds candlelit-paper warmth without lightening the dark cards. Do NOT lay it over the whole dark app background.

panels.how: Skip Kenney nine-slice panels. They're baked-color raster/gradient chrome that won't retheme across the 3 dark themes and would fight the clean CSS rounded-card system (20-30px radius + box-shadow already gives the frame). Keeping the UI CSS-driven is worth more than the borrowed frame.

furniture.how: Cut from the core mock for restraint + extraction cost, but a viable STRETCH: CatumetGamesFurniture.svg is a combined black-stroke sheet — one could extract a single armchair/shelf/lamp, swap stroke:#000 for stroke:currentColor at low opacity (--line), and use it as faint line-art backdrop in the .habitat-window (replacing the CSS hb-lamp/hb-plant placeholders). Only if habitat mock has time.

screensRationale: tabbar (given) showcases all 6 themed nav glyphs recoloring live. care is the hero: it exercises the most asset types at once — a monster-builder Stackling, a vector-emoji mood badge, heart/star meters, moon/sleep/sparkle/camera/check action icons, Eczar headings + numerals, and the nameplate. habitat is the second showcase: the library-window with a multi-creature collection and the parchment/decor treatment. Strong 4th if time: the discover book-card, the only place the star-rating pair, gift, and camera icons all appear together.
